name: nexus-nsh
description: NSH web/desktop client for Nexus Core (tooling only: the app itself is TSX)

scripts.build: npm run gen && nsh package App.tsx --target web --out dist && node scripts/icons-web.mjs dist
scripts.macos: npm run gen && nsh package App.tsx --target macos && node scripts/native-info.mjs .nsh/out/Nexus.app --launch-macos
scripts.macos:open: npm run gen && nsh run App.tsx --target macos
scripts.tui: npm run gen && nsh run App.tsx --target tui
scripts.ios: npm run gen && nsh package App.tsx --target ios-simulator && node scripts/native-info.mjs .nsh/out/Nexus.app --launch-ios
scripts.ios:catalyst: npm run gen && nsh run App.tsx --target catalyst
scripts.ios:device: npm run gen && nsh package App.tsx --target ios && node scripts/native-info.mjs .nsh/out/Nexus.app
scripts.test: npm run gen && nsh test --target web
